roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Redmond, WA?
roles.costP1: Budget $14–$26 per square foot installed for Redmond tile work — that covers the tile, the setting materials, the substrate prep and the labor, with labor by itself starting at $11/sq ft. Expect $3,200–$6,800 for a standard tub-shower surround, and $6,500–$14,000 for a full bathroom with floor, shower and niche.
roles.costP2: Here's the variable most spreadsheets miss: format drives labor harder than material price does. A $4 mosaic sheet often costs more to set than large-format porcelain at $12, because the hours follow cuts and grout lines rather than the invoice.
roles.costNote: Redmond ranges as of August 2026 — tile, materials and labor combined. The written quote from your free estimate is the actual number.
roles.layersLead: Bottom to top, the assembly runs seven layers. When a Redmond shower fails, the post-mortem almost always finds one missing — usually the membrane, trimmed out to save a few hundred bucks on work that later costs five figures to reopen.
roles.whyP1: Leaks run silent for years. Moisture slips past grout, saturates the substrate, and only surfaces as a soft hallway floor or a ceiling stain on the level below. At that point you're paying for framing, subfloor, drywall and a complete re-tile.
roles.whyP2: Run the numbers: waterproofing is roughly 10% of a shower's cost, and deleting it is the most expensive line-item cut in remodeling.
roles.scopeIntro: Every price below is a starting point — format, substrate condition and layout complexity move it. Your exact figure is written on site, free.

roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Redmond, WA?
roles.faqA1: Plan on $14 to $26 per square foot installed for tile in Redmond, counting tile, setting materials, prep and labor; labor by itself starts at $11 per square foot. A standard tub-shower surround prices at $3,200 to $6,800, a bathroom floor of about 45 sq ft at $900 to $1,600, and a complete bathroom with floor, shower and niche typically totals $6,500 to $14,000. Format is the biggest cost lever: mosaics and large-format planks both demand more labor per square foot than a plain 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Redmond?
roles.faqA2: Expect $3,200 to $6,800 for a standard alcove shower in Redmond — demolition, a bonded waterproofing system, the pre-sloped pan, tile, a niche and grout all included. Steam units, benches, curbless entries and full-height stone push past that range. Waterproofing is only about a tenth of the total, and it's the tenth that prevents the five-figure failure.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Always — and we'll show you the spec. Every shower gets a bonded membrane system meeting ANSI A118.10 and TCNA guidance: a pre-sloped base, membrane carried up the walls, sealed seams, corners and penetrations, then a 24-hour flood test that we photograph before any tile is set. Grout and tile shed water briefly; only the membrane actually stops it.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Four to six working days is normal for a Redmond bathroom: demolition and dust control on day one, substrate and waterproofing next with the 24-hour flood test running overnight, one to two days of setting, then a day for grout, silicone and trim. Give the grout 24 hours to cure before the first shower. A floor alone usually takes one to two days.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: For anything wet or walked on, porcelain — it's denser, chips less, and absorbs under 0.5% water. Ceramic costs less and is perfectly good on walls and backsplashes. Our default spec for Redmond projects puts porcelain on every floor and shower floor, with ceramic and glass earning wall space where the design calls for them.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes — and in Redmond it usually comes with a smart-thermostat request, which we're glad to wire in. Electric radiant mat under tile runs $11 to $16 per square foot installed, thermostat included. It sits on an uncoupling membrane, gets resistance-tested before and after tile, and takes a dedicated circuit. The economics only work while the floor is already open, so decide early.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Nine times out of ten, yes. Demo and haul-away run about $3.50 per square foot, and pulling the old tile is the only way to inspect the subfloor for rot and movement and keep the new floor height sane at doorways. Tiling over tile can work on a flat, sound, well-bonded surface, but it stacks height and buries problems better met at demolition than after grout.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Redmond?
roles.faqA8: Figure $1,100 to $2,200 installed for a typical 30 square foot Redmond backsplash, with outlet cuts, edge trim and color-matched grout in the price. Herringbone, mosaic sheets, a framed detail over the range and full-height slab-look porcelain land at the top of the range — layout and cutting time, not material, put them there.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Frequently. Repair and regrout work starts at $8 per square foot and makes sense when grout is stained or breaking down, an impact cracked a tile or two, or shower corners need grout cut out and re-done in silicone. The exception: hollow-sounding tiles, tiles popping in a pattern, or a wall with any give — that's substrate failure, and patching it only rents you a few months. We tell you which case you have before we price anything.
roles.faqQ10: Which Redmond neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: All of Redmond is in range — Downtown, Education Hill, Grass Lawn, Overlake, Idylwood, Viewpoint, the Sammamish Valley, Bear Creek, North Redmond, English Hill, Willows/Rose Hill, Southeast Redmond and Marymoor Village, plus Redmond Ridge, Union Hill and Novelty Hill east of town. Kirkland, Bellevue, Sammamish, Woodinville and the rest of the Eastside are regular territory too.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Tile installation from OC Flooring carries a 2-year workmanship warranty — double our carpet term, because tile problems surface in year two rather than week two. Install a manufacturer's full waterproofing assembly and their system warranty stacks on top. And because the membrane and flood test are photographed, you hold dated documentation of what's behind the tile — useful the day you sell.
